name: dsh-session-detox
description: Session-level cleanup for DSH: scan a session log for the short-line loop pattern, cut it out of the reasoning blocks, and clean the same pattern out of compressed-block summaries. Zero dependencies, pure node.

summary.en: Cleans short-line loops out of DSH session history: trims them from reasoning blocks and compressed-block summaries, and can cut them mid-generation.
summary.zh: 清理 DSH 会话历史里的极短碎句：从思考块和压缩摘要里去掉，也能在生成途中掐断。

author: backpang <backpang@users.noreply.github.com>
